Clay is the relative soft spot: clay_wr_career 0.7179, a clay-minus-hard gap of -0.1363.

context_note: Descriptive career surface win rates as of the corpus end, not a prediction and not an edge claim. Per-surface floors apply (hard/clay/grass n>=30); metrics below floor show n/a rather than a fabricated value, and nothing here adjusts for era, opponent quality, or draw.
